displayName: Job Order (dispatched job on one machine)
description: Level-3 MOM JobOrder (ISA-95 Part 4 / B2MML JobOrder): the job of one machine within a Workorder (WorkRequest) = one workorder operation. The lots it produces point to it (MaterialLot.job_order_ref).

properties.name: job_order_no
properties.description: Identity of the JobOrder (join key): its own number from the source system. It is never built from other keys; the Workorder is reached through workorder_ref (PART_OF).

properties.name: workorder_ref
properties.description: The Workorder (WorkRequest) this job belongs to.

properties.name: machine_ref
properties.description: The machine (Equipment) the job runs on.

properties.name: work_master_ref
properties.description: The work master the job runs by (FOR_WORK_MASTER; ISA-95 Part 4 cl. 7 JobOrder.WorkMasterID). Optional.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Dispatch state of the job as the source names it.

relationships.description: The Workorder this job is part of (ISA-95: WorkRequest MADE_UP_OF JobOrder).
The machine the job runs on (B2MML EquipmentRequirement).

The lots the job consumes or produces (B2MML MaterialRequirement, MaterialUse); 1:n, the key sits on the lot (MaterialLot.job_order_ref, source edge direction in). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/job-order.md, relationships › REQUIRES_MATERIAL.
The work master the job runs by (B2MML JobOrder.WorkMasterID).

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 4 JobOrder = one dispatched job of a WorkRequest; its MaterialLot link is JobOrder REQUIRES_MATERIAL MaterialLot, keyed on the lot side. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/job-order.md, isa95 › note.
isa95.mappingNote: The parent WorkRequest is carried by B2MML through the nesting of JobOrder in WorkRequest, not as a field. Actuals are reported per order and operation (Part 2 SegmentResponse); Part 4 actuals need a source keyed by job.
